items.title: Here’s what Anthropic found when it turned Mythos loose on encryption algorithms - CyberScoop
items.summary: Claude Mythos exposed mathematical weaknesses in a post-quantum candidate and a simplified version of AES, marking a major breakthrough for AI-driven cryptanalysis. Anthropic researchers used Claude Mythos Preview to find new weaknesses in two cryptographic methods, the company said Tuesday, including one that is being considered by the National Institute of Standards and Technology for both traditional and quantum computing. “The attacks described in these two papers are the strongest attacks we have found to date,” the company wrote in the post. One of the weaknesses found was in HAWK, a digital signature scheme under review by the NIST as part of a search for encryption methods that could survive attacks from quantum computers. The other flaw was found in a weakened version of the Advanced Encryption Standard, or AES, the cipher NIST adopted in 2001 and the most widely used method for scrambling data in transit.

items.title: Chicago Quantum Tech Hub Lands Grant for New Supplier Facility - Manufacturing.net
items.summary: The initiative is backed by the state's $500 million investment the Illinois Quantum and Microelectronics Park (IQMP), a planned 128-acre public-private campus on the site of the former U.S. Steel South Works plant on Chicago's Southeast Side. The U.S. Economic Development Administration (EDA) announced that it will award $30 million to The Bloch Quantum Tech Hub in Chicago, a project that looks to scale U.S. production of quantum materials, components and subsystems. Led by the Chicago Quantum Exchange (CQE), The Bloch is part of Illinois' effort to strengthen its critical technology sectors. The CQE said funding from the EDA and the State of Illinois will support construction of the FaQtory, an IQMP supplier facility designed to house quantum suppliers and components manufacturers. The State of Illinois, through the Department of Commerce and Economic Opportunity’s Federal Grant Support Program, has committed $2 million to help support, scale and align all of The Bloch’s projects and investment opportunities by connecting available joint resources and personnel.

items.title: Microsoft’s $60 Million Genesis Mission Commitment Puts Nuclear AI at the Center - POWER Magazine
items.summary: ##### Sign In. Home Nuclear Microsoft’s $60 Million Genesis Mission Commitment Puts Nuclear AI at the Center. # Microsoft’s $60 Million Genesis Mission Commitment Puts Nuclear AI at the Center. Last week, Microsoft announced a $60 million, multiyear commitment to the Department of Energy’s (DOE’s) Genesis Mission, the national initiative to embed artificial intelligence (AI) across the country’s 17 national laboratories. The company’s stated goal, echoing DOE’s own framing, is to help “double the productivity and impact of American research and innovation within a decade.” Two nuclear energy projects anchor the announcement: a research reactor at Purdue University that Idaho National Laboratory (INL) helped adjust remotely and autonomously using distributed cloud computing, and an AI tool built to speed up the document-heavy work of nuclear licensing. Together with background materials on the underlying lab work, the picture that emerges is one of real, specific progress on a research reactor and a documentation tool—building blocks toward a longer-term goal of AI-assisted nuclear deployment.

items.title: HHSC Plan Emphasizes Cybersecurity, AI, Data Governance - GovTech
items.summary: " name="twitter:description"> HHSC Plan Emphasizes Cybersecurity, AI, Data Governance- HHSC plans to modernize cybersecurity with Zero Trust access, continuous monitoring and post-quantum cryptography. - HHSC plans to modernize cybersecurity with Zero Trust access, continuous monitoring and post-quantum cryptography. - Data priorities include analytics for fraud detection, data stewardship policies and a connected analytics data mart. # HHSC Plan Emphasizes Cybersecurity, AI, Data Governance. ## What to Know: * HHSC plans to modernize cybersecurity with Zero Trust access, continuous monitoring and post-quantum cryptography. The Texas Health and Human Services Commission's (HHSC) fiscal years 2027-2031 strategic plan places cybersecurity, artificial intelligence governance, data quality and IT procurement reform among the agency’s core operational priorities. The plan also calls for a curated, flexible data mart with strengthened data governance, technical and business metadata, and improved analytics and reporting capabilities in coordination with the Data Governance and Performance Management council.

items.title: Leonardo DRS to acquire Raft for $450M - Washington Technology
items.summary: # Leonardo DRS to acquire Raft for $450M. ## Leonardo DRS is looking to further build out its advanced sensing and network computing product portfolio. Leonardo DRS has agreed to acquire defense software integrator Raft for $450 million in cash as part of a push to incorporate data fusion and artificial intelligence into military systems. Raft CEO Shubhi Mishra started the company in 2018 to build open architecture software with AI and data integration functions built into the product. In its Tuesday announcement, Leonardo DRS said it is looking to build out its advanced sensing and network computing product portfolio with the addition of Raft. The acquisition of Raft will build on and accelerate the organic investment that DRS has made in that evolution,” Leonardo DRS CEO John Baylouny said in a release. “Raft adds proven software talent and open-architecture technology that complement our existing sensing and computing capabilities and strengthen our ability to deliver AI-enabled mission solutions at the speed our customers demand.”.
